page.title: Attendance
page.description: Time logged against what was expected, per person. Expected days leave out weekends, public holidays and approved leave; overtime is time beyond a day's norm, and every minute on a day without one.

overview.noResultsHint: Try a different search or filter.
overview.emptyDescription: Nobody within your reach was employed in this period.

export.title: Export attendance
export.description: The people in the current view, over the current period. Two sheets: a summary, one row a person, and every logged entry.
export.includedWithMoney: Included: the summary — name, email, status, the five numbers and the amount owed with its currency — and every logged entry with its date, times, hours, description, a note on days without a norm, and the rate it was logged at.
export.included: Included: the summary — name, email, status and the five numbers — and every logged entry with its date, times, hours, description and a note on days without a norm.

person.empty: Nothing was expected and nothing was logged in this period.

notice.holiday: This day is a public holiday ({name}): all time logged on it counts as overtime.
notice.leave: This day is a day of leave: all time logged on it counts as overtime.
notice.outsideEmployment: This day is outside employment: all time logged on it counts as overtime.
notice.notWorkingDay: This day is not a working day: all time logged on it counts as overtime.
notice.daysWithoutNorm: {count} of the picked days have no norm — a weekend, a holiday or leave: all time logged on them counts as overtime.
notice.beyondNorm: This takes the day beyond its norm of {norm}; {overtime} counts as overtime.
notice.daysBeyondNorm: This takes {count} of the picked days beyond their norm; the time above it counts as overtime.

log.invalidSpan: Enter a start and an end on the same day, the end later than the start.
log.loggedOnDays: Time logged on {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
log.pickHint: Pick a day, or drag across several.
log.deleteDescription: {span}{hasDescription, select, yes { · {description}} other {}} will be removed from {date}.

schedule.title: Work schedule
schedule.description: Hours per weekday. Days with no hours are not charged as leave. A schedule is never edited — a change is a new schedule from the date it starts.
schedule.emptyDescription: No personal schedule. The company's working days apply, each at the company's working-day length.

modal.description: Hours per weekday from a date on. Zero means the person does not work that day, and leave is not charged for it. Earlier schedules stay as they were.
modal.hoursRequired: Enter the hours, or 0 for a day off.
modal.hoursInvalid: Enter the hours as 7:30 or 7.5, between 0 and 24.
modal.fromRequired: Choose the date the schedule starts.

settings.chooseDescription: Their work schedules appear here: the hours per weekday, and the date each one starts.
settings.unavailableDescription: Your access does not include this person's employment details.

rate.title: Hourly rate
rate.description: The money field Attendance prices logged time from. A person's rate is copied into each entry when the time is logged, so a later change never re-prices a day already logged. Amounts are shown only to people who may see this field.

workday.title: Working day
workday.description: When a company working day starts, and how long it is. Attendance expects the length of everybody without a personal schedule — anything beyond it is overtime — and Log hours' Full day and Half day start at this time.
workday.invalid: Enter the length of a working day as 8:00 or 7.5, up to 24:00.
